title: First evening with a host family
instructionsHu: Cserediákként megérkeztél egy angol vendégcsaládhoz. Beszélgess a vendéglátó anyukával: kérdezz a házirendről, ajánld fel a segítségedet, és beszéljétek meg a hétvégét. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You are spending two weeks with a host family in York as part of a school exchange programme. It is your first evening in their house, and you are talking to your host mother in the kitchen.
situation.candidateRole: You are the exchange student from Hungary.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is Mrs Parker, your host mother.
goals: Thank her for having you and say something about your journey.
Ask about the house rules, for example meal times or when you have to be home in the evening.
Offer to help with some jobs in the house.
Tell her about one thing you don't eat or are allergic to.
Suggest something you would like to do together at the weekend.
situation.examinerOpening: Hello, come in! Welcome to York. You must be tired. How was your journey?

followUpQuestions: Is there anything you'd like to know about how things work in our house?
That's very kind of you. Is there anything you don't eat? I'm doing the shopping tomorrow.
We're free on Saturday. Is there anything you'd like to do?

usefulPhrases.en: What time do you usually have dinner?
What time should I be home in the evening?
Can I help you with the washing-up?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Hello, come in! Welcome to York. You must be tired. How was your journey?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hello, Mrs Parker. Thank you very much for having me. The journey was long but fine: I flew from Budapest to Manchester, and then I took the train here. I slept a bit on the plane, so I'm not too tired.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: I'm glad to hear that. Is there anything you'd like to know about how things work in our house?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, actually. What time do you usually have dinner? And what time do I have to be home in the evening?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: We have dinner at about six, and we'd like you to be home by ten on weekdays.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: OK, no problem. Can I help you with anything in the house? For example, I could lay the table or do the washing-up after dinner.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: That's very kind of you. Is there anything you don't eat? I'm doing the shopping tomorrow.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Well, I'm allergic to nuts, so I can't eat anything with peanuts or walnuts in it. But I eat everything else, and I'd love to try some typical English dishes.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Don't worry, I'll remember that. We're free on Saturday. Is there anything you'd like to do?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Maybe we could walk along the old city walls together and then have lunch in a café in the centre?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: That's a lovely idea. Let's do that.

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó megköszöni a vendéglátást és beszámol az útjáról, rákérdez a házirendre, felajánlja a segítségét, megemlíti az ételallergiáját, végül programot javasol a hétvégére – mind az öt szempont teljesül, a megadott sorrendben.
Szókincs: a vendégség udvarias fordulatai a helyzethez illők (Thank you very much for having me; Can I help you with anything?; lay the table; allergic to nuts).

Nyelvhelyesség: az utazás leírásában az egyszerű múlt helyes (flew, took, slept), a kötelezettséget a „have to” (What time do I have to be home?), a javaslatot a „could” fejezi ki (Maybe we could …?).
Érdemes megtanulni: „Thank you very much for having me.”, „The journey was long but fine”, „I could lay the table or do the washing-up”, „I'm allergic to nuts”.
